Sandbox_foodWorks_EnableFoodInspection_t: Adds a read-only inventory action showing vanilla food, freshness, preservation, and nutrition state. It never changes the food item.
Sandbox_foodWorks_EnableFruitDryingPrevi: Shows local rack and apple prechecks. It cannot start drying, move items or prove server eligibility.
Sandbox_foodWorks_EnableFruitDrying_tool: Allows new server-owned fruit-drying batches at native small-plant racks. Existing batches retain their saved settings and remain available when disabled.
Sandbox_foodWorks_FruitDryingHours_toolt: Loaded, observed game hours required for new batches. Integer 6–168, step 1; default 48. Unloaded racks and long observation gaps pause drying. No electricity, water or weather simulation is used.
Sandbox_foodWorks_FruitDryingShelfLifeMu: Integer 1–12, step 1; default 6. New batches scale both freshness thresholds and carried age together. Drying never resets age or adds calories. Existing batches keep their saved multiplier.
Sandbox_foodWorks_EnableSweetPreserves_t: Allows new server-owned batches at a powered stove heated to at least 100 C. Existing sealed jars can still be opened when disabled.
Sandbox_foodWorks_SweetPreservesShelfLif: Sealed jam and jelly fresh days
Integer 7-180, step 1; default 30. Rotten threshold is twice this. Carried relative fruit age is retained. Opened jars use 3/6 days. Existing jars keep their native food thresholds.
Sandbox_foodWorks_SweetPreservesTimeMult: Jam and jelly action time multiplier
Integer 1-5, step 1; default 1. Scales native action duration: jam 600, jelly 900, opening 40 action units. Server timing is authoritative.
Sandbox_foodWorks_JellyJuiceYieldPercent: Integer 25-90, step 1; default 70. This fraction of fruit food values goes into jelly; the rest returns as perishable edible pulp. All sugar remains in the jelly. Existing outputs are unchanged.
